Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study contains two distinct proteomics approaches: 1) A global label-free quantitative proteome analysis of Ramos B cells (LFQ/iBAQ) and 2) A SILAC-based affinity purification (Co-IP) using a PTP1B substrate trapping mutant to identify phosphotyrosine-dependent interactors. Both utilized DDA acquisition (TOP12/TOP15).

organism: The species was restricted to homo sapiens as Ramos B cells are of human origin.
cell_lines: human Burkitt’s lymphoma B cell line Ramos
scope: For LC-MS analysis of affinity-purified samples (SILAC Co-IP)

the remaining sample was mixed with 40 μl FLAG M2 magnetic beads (Sigma). The samples were incubated for 2–4 h on a rotating wheel at 8°C, washed 3× with 1 ml lysis buffer and eluted with 40 μl 1× sample buffer
For MS analysis, the proteins were eluted with 40 μl 3× FLAG peptide (Sigma-Aldrich)
